rootGitlinkSync.remediation: Rerun the current cross-surface and fresh-checkout/public gates after any subsequent revision change.

assetProvenance.releaseWorkflowContract: desktop-release.yml writes specRevision, specDigest, specManifestSha256, and specManifestPath into each target metadata file and requires one consistent set while creating release-manifest.json

artifactPolicy.historicalArtifactRule: Historical archives remain historical when their Flutter or root pointer differs from currentRevisionTuple.
artifactPolicy.runtimeRule: Build, archive, checksum, and bundle-shape evidence never implies launch, picker, MCP, accessibility, installation, signing, or deployment success.
artifactPolicy.promotionRule: A target may be promoted only with an artifact checksum joined to this tuple and a target-host smoke transcript.

localArtifactInspection.claimLimit: This inspection proves archive presence, bundle shape, and checksum only; it does not join the archives to the current tuple or prove packaged runtime smoke.
